# ConfigurationManager
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/config-contracts/src/contracts/ConfigurationManager.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IConfigurationManager](../interfaces/i-configuration-manager.md), ProtocolAccessManaged

**Title:**
ConfigurationManager

Manages system-wide configuration parameters for the protocol

**Note:**
see: IConfigurationManager


## State Variables
### initialized
Indicates whether the configuration manager has been initialized


```solidity
bool public initialized
```


### raft
Get the address of the Raft contract

This is where rewards and farmed tokens are sent for processing


```solidity
address public raft
```


### tipJar
Get the current tip jar address

This is the contract that owns tips and is responsible for
dispensing them to claimants


```solidity
address public tipJar
```


### treasury
Get the current treasury address

This is the contract that owns the treasury and is responsible for
dispensing funds to the protocol's operations


```solidity
address public treasury
```


### harborCommand
Get the address of theHarbor command

This is the contract that's the registry of all Fleet Commanders


```solidity
address public harborCommand
```


### fleetCommanderRewardsManagerFactory
Get the address of the Fleet Commander Rewards Manager Factory contract


```solidity
address public fleetCommanderRewardsManagerFactory
```
